hero.title: Last Seen — Series Premiere
hero.date: 2-ep premiere live Wed Sep 9, 2026 — weekly Wednesdays through Oct 7
hero.about: Australian crime thriller from Kris Mrksa, adapting Ryan David Jahn's novel The Dispatcher. Patrick Brammall stars as Ian Ridley, a former detective who becomes convinced that a random distress call could be his daughter — eleven years after she disappeared. First two eps live; weekly Wednesdays.
hero.why: You loved Slow Horses (Loved list) and Silo (4.5⭐) — this is the same Apple TV+ prestige-thriller pocket: character-first, quiet, patient, values people over plot twists (per Roger Ebert). Early RT is strong (82–100% range as reviews come in). Already #4 worldwide on Apple TV. Two 55-min eps is a perfect 2-night bedtime binge to catch up before Slow Horses S6 drops next Wednesday.
